title: Nine degree-111 cyclic fields with punctured anchor parity and a repeated bit

claims.statement: The explicit nine-field degree-111 punctured cyclic encoder, its radius-25 adaptive decoder, and the five-coordinate majority-protected bit carry 1000 bits on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses with average block error at most 123004948073816879/1000000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder, including majority and output packing, executes at most W=123188796072353641708753665975402158045817211354180 operations on every input, with W<=2^(83199/500).

experiments.purpose: Check exact QR weight profiles, field, orbits and work (0), weighted child admission (1), all eight exact proper-run ceilings (2 and 3), and combine the total rational error (3).
